info.title: MuseCanvas Agent Core control plane
info.description: P4 admission/query API. AGENT_CORE_ENABLED defaults false; AGENT_CORE_ADMISSION_READY is a second explicit gate for new sessions/messages. This document does not claim a Runner, tool executor, media provider call, or UI.

tags.name: agent-core
tags.description: Owner-scoped durable control-plane intent and finite event replay

post.description: Feature-disabled namespace returns 404 before authentication, DB or rate Redis. Enabled requires an active authenticated owner; missing and cross-owner resources return the same 404. No Runner/tool/provider execution. Same-origin validation required. JSON body max 40000 bytes and 5 second read deadline. Body request ID is the sole authority; any Idempotency-Key header is rejected (400). clientRequestId is owner-global. Same key/body replays the frozen response even when admission is closed or definition retired; different body is 409. New sessions require AGENT_CORE_ADMISSION_READY=true and validated active owner/system definition.

get.description: Feature-disabled namespace returns 404 before authentication, DB or rate Redis. Enabled requires an active authenticated owner; missing and cross-owner resources return the same 404. No Runner/tool/provider execution. Cursor is canonical decimal <= int64 maximum. Last-Event-ID is sessionId:cursor and must equal query cursor if both supplied (409 otherwise); cross-session/invalid IDs are 400. Ahead cursor is 409 before streaming. Frames have id/event/data. ready does not advance cursor. Heartbeat every ~5s; PG polling ~500ms, no connection held during waits; closes normally after 25s. Reconnect with last delivered ID; retention/gap/backlog emits resync.required and closes: fetch consistent snapshot, paginate all items until hasMore=false up to lastItemSequence, then reconnect at snapshot eventCursor. Max 500 durable events/~1MB per connection; slow/aborted readers cannot cancel Turns.

Enabled requires an active authenticated owner; missing and cross-owner resources return the same 404. No Runner/tool/provider execution. Same-origin validation required. JSON body max 40000 bytes and 5 second read deadline. Body request ID is the sole authority; any Idempotency-Key header is rejected (400). Terminal or already cancel-requested replay is idempotent. Safe queued/waiting turns cancel locally only when all tool calls and approvals are terminal and all reservations are settled or released; unknown or retained dependencies preserve status/active turn/leases, recording cancellation and a durable wake for a future Runner. Running work likewise only records cancellation and a durable wake, preserving its lease.

post.description: Feature-disabled namespace returns 404 before authentication, DB or rate Redis. Enabled requires an active authenticated owner; missing and cross-owner resources return the same 404. No Runner/tool/provider execution. Same-origin validation required. JSON body max 40000 bytes and 5 second read deadline. Body request ID is the sole authority; any Idempotency-Key header is rejected (400). Decision records intent only; checks immutable arguments hash, expiry, current cancellation and model/pricing reservation binding. Identical final decision replays fixed decision_revision; opposite decision/hash is 409. Rejection never cancels entire Turn; acceptance never blindly queues it.

NoIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
NoIdempotencyKey.description: Rejected: request IDs in the JSON body are the sole idempotency authority.

NotFound.description: Missing or foreign owner-scoped resource; disabled feature also uses 404

Unavailable.description: Feature/admission gate closed or safe definition unavailable

content.description: Nonblank PostgreSQL-compatible UTF-8 text. Maximum 32000 UTF-8 bytes (x-maxUtf8Bytes); a multibyte string may pass maxLength and still be rejected by runtime byte validation. No NUL or unpaired surrogate.

ApprovalSummary.description: revision is the parent Turn revision frozen at decision time when final, or current Turn revision when pending; not an independent approval counter.
